collections.name: FlyLight Generation 1 MCFO
collections.description: MultiColor FlpOut (MCFO) stochastic-labeling light microscopy of the FlyLight Generation 1 GAL4 driver line collection, including expert-annotated subsets.

collections.name: FlyLight Split-GAL4
collections.description: Curated Split-GAL4 driver lines from published studies, each targeting specific cell types. Individual releases correspond to the publications that generated or used those lines.

collections.name: FlyLight Split-GAL4 Omnibus Broad
collections.description: A broad screening collection of Split-GAL4 driver lines aggregated across many FlyLight studies.

collections.name: FlyEM Male CNS
collections.description: An electron microscopy (EM) reconstruction of the male central nervous system (Male CNS), covering both the brain and the ventral nerve cord.

collections.name: FlyEM Hemibrain
collections.description: A dense electron microscopy (EM) connectome covering the central brain of a female Drosophila, reconstructed by Janelia's FlyEM team.

collections.name: FlyEM MANC
collections.description: The Male Adult Nerve Cord (MANC) electron microscopy connectome, a complete reconstruction of the ventral nerve cord of a male Drosophila.

collections.name: FlyWire Brain
collections.description: The Full Adult Fly Brain (FAFB) electron microscopy connectome, proofread by the FlyWire community and realigned for NeuronBridge color depth matching.

collections.name: FlyWire BANC
collections.description: The Brain-And-Nerve-Cord (BANC) electron microscopy connectome from the FlyWire project, spanning both the brain and the ventral nerve cord of an adult Drosophila.
